title: SolutionState
description: T07 design note ruling round 2 (V17 F1), ADR 0020 D4 as amended: `solution-state.json`, the state the verifier judged, written in a revision bundle exactly when `solution-certificate.json` is. `variable_ids` is the verifier's `spec.variable_ids`, in the order `state_sha256` is defined over; `variables` maps each of them to its binary64 value in unprefixed SI (ADR 0001 D1.1): amount flow mol/s, temperature K, pressure Pa, heat rate W, fractions dimensionless. `state_sha256` is `canonical.state_sha256` of the values in `variable_ids` order and equals the certificate's `target_state_sha256`. That `variables` has exactly the ids of `variable_ids`, and both hash identities, are checked by `process_runtime.run.solution_state.inconsistencies`, which JSON Schema cannot express. The file carries no run id and no verdict: its provenance is its bundle.
